dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit stippled, high-contrast white perimeters. The geometry is irregular and non-concentric, with the high-intensity pixels forming a sharp, jagged boundary between the dark-blue exterior and the dark-blue interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters, predominantly found along a jagged linear ridge connecting the larger annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as irregular, bright stippling against the dark fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct circular annuli in the lower-central and right-lateral regions form an obtuse scalene triangle. This configuration is flanked by a linear chain of three smaller, less-defined annuli on the upper-left dorsal aspect.
